criteria: Idea and scene to final prompt fidelity

cases.subject: A woman doing funny stuff
cases.constraints: Preserve the same character identity. One readable comic situation per image; include broad interpretations, not only mishaps.

cases.subject: A dog going on small adventures
cases.constraints: Keep the same dog and markings. Use safe everyday adventures with visibly different activities.

cases.subject: A fantasy knight doing ordinary office work
cases.constraints: Same knight and armor throughout. All scenes indoors, each with a different office activity.

cases.subject: An old man trying different sports
cases.constraints: Same elderly man and physical traits. Safe attempts at different sports, not one sport in different locations.

cases.subject: A sneaker being used in everyday situations
cases.constraints: Preserve the sneaker's design and color. Distinct credible use contexts, not human expressions on the shoe.

cases.subject: A recurring couple on different dates
cases.constraints: Same two adults and their relationship. Different visible shared activities, not just portraits at different venues.

cases.subject: A character doing household chores
cases.constraints: Same identity and outfit. Indoor scenes only. Different chores with one readable task per scene.

cases.subject: A robot trying human hobbies
cases.constraints: Same robot design. Different visible hobbies, not changes to its construction.

cases.subject: A woman posing confidently
cases.constraints: Same identity. Physically interpretable varied poses; gaze need not always be toward the viewer.

cases.subject: A woman doing different funny facial expressions
cases.constraints: Same identity. Different facial expressions are the requested idea space, not duplicate-category failures.

cases.subject: A product used in creative situations
cases.constraints: Use the same handheld flashlight. Distinct creative uses with physically understandable light paths and object placement.

cases.subject: A robot doing human jobs
cases.constraints: Preserve its construction. Different recognizable jobs; hands, tools and objects must occupy reachable positions.
